pluginFunctions.name: UberMind Status

openaiSpec.name: ubermind_gateway_status
openaiSpec.description: Check the source/config readiness of the UberMind Infinite Opus gateway. This performs no model inference and grants no semantic or external-effect authority.

pluginFunctions.name: Plan with UberMind

openaiSpec.name: ubermind_plan_task
openaiSpec.description: Ask UberMind to classify a zero-effect task into exact/E0-E4, Jev shadow, scout/challenger, strong-worker, hard-escalation, or Crown-page-fault lanes. Use before expensive reasoning when the task may be recurring, exactly verifiable, or compilation-eligible. The returned plan is not itself final semantic authority.

taskId.description: Unique stable task id using letters, digits, dot, slash, colon, underscore or hyphen.

taskClass.description: Typed task class such as RESEARCH, ROUTINE_CODING, PROVIDER_SCREENING, NOVEL_STRATEGY.

stakes.description: Known stakes class such as LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH. Never UNKNOWN.

dynamicContextEndpoints.name: UberMind Infinite Opus Law
dynamicContextEndpoints.staticContent: <SYSTEM>UberMind Infinite Opus is active as a planning/proof tool. Before expensive reasoning on recurring or structured tasks, use ubermind_plan_task. E0-E4 current proofs may avoid repeated model-vs-model quality tests. Jev is a bounded semantic control plane, not a Crown. Cheap/strong models create proposals; material open-ended semantics still require exact closure, certified bounded authority, or current Crown admission. Never claim the 33,333.333x target unless the execution/economic ledger proves it. Never put OpenRouter keys, admin tokens, passwords, cookies or credentials into tool arguments.</SYSTEM>
